purpose: Vorschaubild für das dritte Homepage-Video: Jackie Leven at 70.
reference_roles: Identitäten beider Musiker, Gesang, Gitarren, Hände, Kleidung und häusliche Umgebung
Ausschließlich die fotografische Schwarzweiß-Tonalität des ersten Video-Vorschaubilds
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: 16:9 widescreen photographic video preview for a dark music tribute website. Create one finished 1672 x 941 landscape image.
Input images: Image 1 is the original video screenshot and is the ONLY source for the identities, appearance, ages, poses, clothing, instruments, room and performance. Image 2 is ONLY a style reference for restrained neutral black-and-white photography, soft grain and dark tones. Do not use the man, face, hairstyle, clothing or concert stage in Image 2.
Primary request: Reinterpret the home-recorded acoustic duet in Image 1 as an intimate, natural monochrome photograph, visually related to the understated photographic video poster in Image 2. Preserve BOTH distinct musicians faithfully. They are two different people, neither should be replaced with Jackie Leven or the performer in Image 2.
Subjects: On the left, the older white-haired man with his specific full face, open singing mouth, light botanical patterned short-sleeve shirt and dark guitar strap. On the right, the man with short receding hair, slim face, eyes closed mid-song, rounded singing mouth and small-check short-sleeve button-down shirt. Keep their natural ages, facial structure and body proportions. Preserve their seated side-by-side positions, separate microphones entering from either side, both acoustic guitars and all four hands in their natural playing positions. Faithful expressions and unretouched faces, no idealizing.
Composition: eye-level two-person medium shot based on Image 1, both faces clearly visible in the upper half, both guitar bodies filling the lower half with necks extending to the right as in the screenshot. Balanced attention to both men. Leave a little breathing room above their heads, and retain their spatial relationship. The rightmost guitar neck may continue out of frame as in the reference. Keep the gesture, intimacy and casual home-performance atmosphere.
Environment: keep this recognizably a kitchen, but simplify and darken the background markedly into charcoal. A few shelves and hanging pots on the left and the cooker hood in the middle remain as very quiet, softly focused shapes. Reduce distracting notices, posters, cabinetry details and the bright hanging lamp. No invented stage, spotlights, audience, dramatic light beams or new objects. Remove the bright sliver of paper at the lower edge so the photograph fades naturally into dark tones there.
Lighting and palette: neutral black, graphite and silver greys ONLY; absolutely no sepia, brown or coloured tint. Background substantially darker than the musicians, outer edges near #0d0f12. Soft natural-looking illumination on faces and hands, clear midtones, restrained white hair highlights, guitar wood rendered in muted grey rather than glaring white. Preserve quiet texture in the shirts and instruments without noisy fine detail.
Style: subtle photographic rendering, smooth tonal transitions, gentle matte analogue grain and a little optical softness. No drawing, brushstrokes, artificial sharpening, glamour retouching, synthetic skin or heavy vignette ring. Match Image 2's softness and neutral tonality while respecting the ordinary domestic setting.
Constraints: exactly two musicians from Image 1; no identity mixing with Image 2. No lettering, titles, caption, play icon, border or watermark. Anatomically coherent hands and playable guitars. No extra fingers or extra strings.
